newsitem.title: CHINA: HK to tender two-yr Exchange Fund notes on Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: HK to tender two-yr Exchange Fund notes on Aug 11.

text.p: Hong Kong will tender the 18th issue of two-year Exchange Fund Notes on August 11, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said in a statement on Monday.
Notes worth HK$500 million will be offered, with another HK$100 million to be held as reserve by the HKMA for supply to market makers in the secondary market. Settlement will take place next Tuesday.
The notes, to mature on August 12, 1999, will carry interest at 6.30 percent per annum payable semi-annually in arrears.
